_comment_1: Project-level: save as .claude/settings.json in the addon repo.
_comment_2: Note: a project settings file cannot set the default mode to 'auto' or 'bypassPermissions' for terminal sessions — only ~/.claude/settings.json can. Use --permission-mode auto on the command line, or set it in your user settings.
_comment_3: Do not use bypassPermissions / --dangerously-skip-permissions outside an isolated container.
